description: This file defines the main page component of a React-based note-taking application, handling authentication gating, loading states, and rendering core UI components like Sidebar, NoteList, and NoteEditor within the app layout.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main application page component that manages authentication state and renders the full notes app or loading/auth modal accordingly.

methods.name: NotesApp
methods.description: Inner component that renders the application's core UI layout with Sidebar, NoteList, and NoteEditor components, invoked when user is authenticated.
